title: Spare Parts
summary: Judy asks V to walk Kabuki Market with her to buy a matrix from a stall owner who likes mercs.
description: Judy's rig fried a matrix, and the stall owner at Kabuki Market who has one likes mercs better than editors. She asks V to walk the market with her and haggle.

start.bringUp: Judy is fixing a rig and needs a matrix that is not sold anywhere respectable. Bring up, casually and in your own way, that you want V at Kabuki Market for a couple of hours to walk around and haggle. Say the stall owner likes mercs better than editors.

market.name: the central stairs of Kabuki Market

stall.name: the matrix stall in Kabuki Market

J1.ask.01.text: Fried a matrix. The guy who sells them likes mercs better than editors. You're a merc.

J1.ask.02.text: Kabuki Market, couple hours? I'll buy you noodles. Bad ones.

J1.stalls.01.text: Okay. Rule one, don't touch anything that's humming.

J1.stalls.02.text: See this? Pre-unification BD wreath. Owned by a war hero. ...Nah, it's a hairnet.

J1.stalls.03.text: That stall sold me my first scanner. I was fourteen and broke. Grandpa paid.

J1.haggle.01.text: That's him. Let you do the talking. I'll do the looking unimpressed.

J1.haggle.02.text: You're terrifying. Do that to my landlord.

J1.hand.01.text: Here. Made it last night. Don't say it's cute.

J1.end.01.text: Got the matrix myself. Paid full price. Thanks for nothing, merc.

g1.asks: What about you, ever had someone who paid for your dumb stuff?
g1.know: You are walking Kabuki Market with V. The matrix is on a stall, and your grandfather paid for your first scanner.

stages.label: Judy is waiting at the Kabuki Market stairs
stages.objective: Meet Judy at the central stairs of Kabuki Market
stages.know: Your rig fried a matrix, and the stall owner who has one likes mercs. You are waiting on the central stairs of Kabuki Market, and you will never say that you want the company.
stages.wants: V to come to Kabuki Market for a couple of hours.

stages.label: Judy is walking V through the stalls
stages.objective: Walk Kabuki Market with Judy toward the matrix stall
stages.know: You and V are walking Kabuki Market. You turn junk into treasure stories and then ruin them, and you are steering V toward the stall that has the matrix.
stages.wants: V to keep walking the market with you.

stages.label: Judy waits while V haggles for the matrix
stages.objective: Haggle with Judy for the matrix at the Kabuki Market stall
stages.know: The trader has the matrix at his stall and wants more than it is worth. He takes less from a merc who talks well. You are watching V work the deal and trying not to look impressed.
stages.wants: V to talk the price down or pay it.

stages.label: Judy hands V a keychain she made
stages.objective: Take the keychain Judy hands you at the end of the walk
stages.know: The matrix is in hand. You made a holo-keychain last night and you are handing it over at the end of the walk. You will not say it is a gift.

stages.label: Judy pays for the matrix herself
stages.objective: Watch Judy pay the trader for the matrix
stages.know: The matrix did not come out of V's money, so you paid the trader yourself. You grumble about it and you will tease V about it later.

bargain.memory: You haggled the stall owner at Kabuki Market down for Judy's matrix, and she has not stopped telling people.

judy-paid.memory: Judy paid for her matrix at Kabuki Market herself and teased you for being cheap.

stood-up.memory: You never came to Kabuki Market, so Judy got the matrix herself at full price.
